'''Zebulun''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] he and his squad were sent by [[Numen Brock]] to the [[Malak Memorial Research Base]], where they took over [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]], a deserter from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], from the hands of the [[Voidhound]] to deliver him to the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]]. However, the incompetent Moff suggested a shortcut that led them right past the Imperial barracks and got the whole squad, Zebulun included, killed.
